items.proposed: BRAF row coded exploratory_correlative, candidate_matched false
items.reason: BRAF V600E appears only as a qualifier of ependymoma inside an example list: "(e.g., anaplastic astrocytoma (high grade), recurrent ependymoma BRAFV600E or GBM)"; it is not an entry requirement for GBM patients and is not matched to the PRMT5 inhibitor SKL27969, so the primary outcome is false either way.
No eligibility or enrichment tumour biomarker applies to the trial or a cohort; the BRAF mention is a diagnostic example for ependymoma, not a selection criterion.

note: Agreed codings stand: basket (GBM named in inclusion criterion 6), cns5 (cites 2021 WHO), PK planned without sample type (unclear), PD named without a measurement (unclear). D31: BRAF row recoded exploratory_correlative under A1; primary outcome and any_molecular_selection stay false. Nothing pending for XL.

revisions.to: BRAF row coded exploratory_correlative, candidate_matched false
revisions.reason: BRAF V600E qualifies only the non-GBM ependymoma example ("recurrent ependymoma BRAFV600E or GBM"), GBM patients enter without it, so A1 codes the row exploratory_correlative rather than dropping it.
